display_name: Lift Canonical Pointer For Duplicate Sessions
description:
One-shot operator-only pre-flight repair for the M18 partial-unique index `idx_session_canonical_one_per_vendor_pair` (next blue-green cutover). Resolves duplicate `(vendor, external_session_id)` groups where BOTH rows have `canonical_external_session_id IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0` BEFORE the partial-unique index CREATE op fires.

The M18 partial-unique index will be emitted by schema_diff on the next green spawn (once the schema_diff machinery fix has landed). If duplicate canonical pairs exist in operator's live ledger when CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fires, the op aborts with `duplicate key value violates unique constraint`, the schema migration aborts, green spawn FATALs, blue-green never completes. This verb prevents that failure mode by lifting the data into a partial-unique-compatible shape ahead of the index landing.

Flow. The verb wraps the per-group lift in a try/finally pause-resume envelope around the importer-poll cron (mirrors the precedent of `backfill_first_last_event_at_repair`): (1) `scheduling_service.clear_scheduled_actions_by_tag(tag)` pauses ingest so a concurrent poll can't INSERT a third canonical sibling into a group mid-repair; (2) `lift_canonical_pointer_for_duplicate_sessions` iterates duplicate groups (each `(vendor, external_session_id)` pair with ≥ 2 canonical-NULL rows), picks the chronologically-first row by `created_at ASC, id ASC` tie-break as the surviving canonical row, and writes `canonical_external_session_id = <first row's external_session_id>` onto every sibling inside a per-group `transactional()` block with `FOR UPDATE` locks; (3) the `finally` block calls `ensure_periodic_poll_schedule(cadence_minutes, tag)` so the cron resumes even when the loop raises.

Default `confirm=False` returns a structured dry-run carrying the `duplicate_group_count` (and `resume_outcome='skipped'`, since dry-run never pauses). Pass `confirm=true` to actually run the lift.

This verb is `is_discoverable=False` — the model cannot find it via process_search and never proposes it. Operator-only via the operator bridge.
embedding_description: Operator-only ledger pre-flight: resolve duplicate canonical (vendor, external_session_id) groups before M18 partial-unique index idx_session_canonical_one_per_vendor_pair lands on next cutover. Picks chronologically-first row per group as canonical; lifts siblings. Pauses importer-poll cron, per-group FOR UPDATE transactions, resumes cron in finally. Default dry-run; confirm=true to commit.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Lift Canonical Pointer For Duplicate Sessions
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Lift outcome. `confirmed=false` is a dry-run; `confirmed=true` ran the per-group demotion. `duplicate_group_count` is the count of `(vendor, external_session_id)` groups with ≥ 2 canonical-NULL rows at start; `demoted_count` is the total number of sibling rows demoted to canonical-pointer (one less than the per-group row count, summed across groups).
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: After a confirmed lift, re-run the verb with `confirm=False` to verify `duplicate_group_count == 0`. Then the next blue-green cutover is safe for the partial-unique index CREATE op. If `duplicate_group_count` is non-zero on the re-probe, a race may have INSERTed a new duplicate after the lift; investigate via list_sessions filtered to the surfaced (vendor, external_session_id) pair, then re-run the lift.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Pre-flight pause-and-lift pass over `__session` duplicate canonical groups; pauses importer-poll cron, lifts siblings to canonical pointer, resumes cron in finally-block
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: LedgerRepositoryError: the underlying state_service rejected one of the per-group UPDATE statements OR the pause/resume scheduling call failed. If scheduling_service was None, the verb fails fast before the lift loop. Possible causes: schema not yet initialized, state_service unavailable, scheduling_service unbound on this profile.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Confirm scheduling_service is bound (per-profile). Confirm schema is initialized via list_sources. The finally-block re-ensures the importer-poll cron even on exception; if the verb itself raised before the pause call, the cron was never paused and is still running. If the dry-run shows surprisingly large duplicate_group_count values, inspect a sample via list_sessions filtered by vendor before confirming.
